biomes.architectural_note: Suspended steel walkway beneath a 26m laminated-timber mist dome.
Rammed-earth thermal plinths beneath angled low-iron solar louvers.
Cross-ventilated limestone scree beds cooled by geothermal loops.

specimens.summary: Serpentine-soil pitcher plant thriving in cool nocturnal fog.
specimens.careNotes: Irrigated exclusively with reverse-osmosis rainwater; root zone chilled to 15°C nightly.

specimens.summary: Epiphytic Andean orchid mounted on porous tree-fern plaques.
specimens.careNotes: Constant buoyant airflow required; zero direct midday solar exposure.

specimens.summary: Ancient fibrous-trunk fern anchoring the mist canyon canopy.
specimens.careNotes: Crown misted thrice daily to hydrate emerging fiddlehead croziers.

specimens.summary: Pendulous coral panicles draped along humid understory walkways.
specimens.careNotes: Coarse bark epiphyte medium with dappled canopy shade.

specimens.summary: Millennium-scale gymnosperm bearing only two endlessly growing leaves.
specimens.careNotes: Ultra-deep 4m mineral taproot column; fog-condensation misting only.

specimens.summary: Silver-spined succulent stem storing seasonal monsoon reserves.
specimens.careNotes: Pumice-dominant mineral substrate; bone-dry dormancy below 14°C.

specimens.summary: Spineless eight-ribbed dome speckled with trichome scales.
specimens.careNotes: Protected from overhead splash; bottom-wicked mineral watering.

specimens.summary: Dichotomous branching tree aloe flowering with canary-gold spikes.
specimens.careNotes: Winter-active growth regime with high-silica granite scree.

specimens.summary: Tight arctic-alpine cushion carpeting lime-rich scree ledges.
specimens.careNotes: Sub-surface chilled limestone grit prevents crown rot during thaw.

specimens.summary: Cobalt-bell alpine perennial tuned to intense UV irradiance.
specimens.careNotes: Requires cool night air exchange and acid-lean granite gravel.

specimens.summary: Woolly star-bracts engineered to deflect high-altitude UV radiation.
specimens.careNotes: Dry winter overhead shelter with brisk cross-ventilation.

specimens.summary: Fringed violet bells emerging directly beside melting snowfields.
specimens.careNotes: Maintained at 4°C winter vernalization prior to early spring display.
